name: lingcoo-official-website-system
description: LingcooTech official website and inquiry operations system built as a Frame Consumer.

scripts.build:all: npm run build:packages && npm run build:system && npm run build:admin && npm run build:web
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:packages && npm run migrate --workspace @lingcootech/official-system
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint
